# lib/layout-effect

## Variables

### useIsomorphicLayoutEffect

```ts
const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect: (effect, deps?) => void;
```

`useLayoutEffect` in a browser, `useEffect` where there is no document. React
warns that a layout effect does nothing during server rendering; an effect that
never runs there is the same behavior without the warning.

The signature is identical to `useEffect`, but it fires synchronously after all
DOM mutations. Use this to read layout from the DOM and synchronously re-render.
Updates scheduled inside `useLayoutEffect` will be flushed synchronously, before
the browser has a chance to paint.

Prefer the standard `useEffect` when possible to avoid blocking visual updates.

If you’re migrating code from a class component, `useLayoutEffect` fires in the
same phase as `componentDidMount` and `componentDidUpdate`.

| `effect`  | `EffectCallback` |
| `deps?`   | `DependencyList` |

#### Returns
